paper_title: MIG Automatic Data Selection for Instruction Tuning by Maximizing   Information Gain in Semantic Space
caption: figure
model_annotation: This bar chart, titled “Quality Scores,” displays four distinct quality metrics—labeled “Base Avg_ety,” “Base Avg_sub,” “Avg_ety,” and “Avg_sub”—across three categories on the horizontal axis: “IFD,” “TagNum,” and “DEITA.” The vertical axis, labeled “Scores,” is scaled linearly from 30 to 70, with tick marks at regular intervals of 5. Each category contains two bars: a light blue bar representing “Avg_ety” and a salmon-colored bar representing “Avg_sub,” with their respective values labeled directly above each bar. For the “IFD” category, the “Avg_ety” score is 63.98 and the “Avg_sub” score is 41.90. For the “TagNum” category, the “Avg_ety” score is 66.06 and the “Avg_sub” score is 39.13. For the “DEITA” category, the “Avg_ety” score is 67.64 and the “Avg_sub” score is 42.99. Additionally, two horizontal reference lines are present: a dashed blue line at approximately 64.71, corresponding to the “Base Avg_ety” metric, and a dashed orange line at approximately 38.5, corresponding to the “Base Avg_sub” metric. The bars are arranged in the order of the categories as labeled on the x-axis, from left to right, and are not sorted by value. The legend in the upper right corner explicitly identifies the color and line style for each metric.
